meta.purpose: Reviewed exceptions to the recorded Forever Talent tooltip, applied on every item-stats rebuild
meta.priority: Only apply corrections backed by newer Forever client and independent item pages; never import malformed spell parameter placeholders
meta.notes: Tooltip text from the newer Forever client takes precedence over missing old tooltip effects.

7348.reviewFlag: Parry-effekten skiljer sig mellan Forever-källor. Wowhead och vissa databaser anger -1% Parry, medan en nyare klientdatabas återger +1%. Kontrollera mot item-tooltip i spelet.
7348.reason: Sign and wording of the parry effect disagree between client-based databases; keep previous sourced effect until in-game confirmation.

8197.reviewFlag: Stealth-effekten har olika värden i Forever-källor: +1 respektive +1.2. Nuvarande värde kommer från vår ursprungliga tooltipkälla; verifiera gärna i spelet.
8197.reason: Second client source displays +1.2 stealth where other Forever item sources show +1; no automatic replacement.

18251.reviewFlag: Source conflict: Core Armor Kit's exact Defense bonus and minimum item level differ between Forever item databases. Verify the in-game tooltip before using this effect value.
18251.reason: Wowhead Forever presents +4 Defense and item level 0+, whereas Forever Mastery/ForeverDB show +3 Defense and item level 45+. No reliable live observation to settle this conflict; do not guess.

18508.reason: Forever Talent's old tooltip omitted this Equip effect, but newer client and independent item pages confirm +41 ranged Attack Power.

20380.reason: Original imported tooltip omitted the Mana-per-5 Equip effect confirmed in Wowhead Forever and multiple Forever item databases.

252603.reviewFlag: Intellect-värdet skiljer sig mellan Forever-källor: +31 (bl.a. Wowhead och äldre beräknad tooltip) eller +32 (nyare klientbaserade tabeller). Behåll befintligt värde tills det kan bekräftas i spelet.
252603.reason: The data-driven item-budget scaling yields 31 or 32 Intellect depending on the source/build; preserve source value 31 and surface conflict.

effects: Use: Permanently increase the Defense Skill by 4 and the Stamina value by 10 of an item worn on the chest, legs, hands, or feet. Only usable on items level 45 and above.
279258.reason: Old source incorrectly resolves dynamic stamina as 0 and item threshold as 0; item and spell effects specify +4 defense skill, +10 stamina, usable at item level 45+.
